# MFL Football

> MFL Football (mfl.football, formerly MFL Add-ons) builds free tools, live scoring, apps and custom league sites for MyFantasyLeague (MFL) fantasy football leagues. It is independent and not affiliated with MyFantasyLeague.

## Products

- [MFL Add-ons is now MFL Football](https://mfl.football/addons.md): every product in one list, in markdown. Free tools, league addresses and logo hosting, the TV and phone apps, and league sites.
- [Team logo maker](https://mfl.football/live/team-logo): free. Writes an AI prompt for a fantasy team logo in your colors, to paste into ChatGPT, Gemini or Claude.
- [Live scores](https://mfl.football/live): free live scoring across every MFL league an owner plays in.
- [MFL skin and templates](https://mfl.football/instructions): free light and dark themes, plus a homepage, header and footer for MFL league pages.

## Optional

- [Source code](https://github.com/braven112/mfl.football.v2)
- [CSS customization prompt](https://mfl.football/theleague/css-customization#claude-prompt): a ready-made prompt to help someone override CSS variables in their MFL Homepage Message.
- [Adding icons to the SVG sprite](https://mfl.football/theleague/css-customization#adding-icons): a ready-made prompt to convert SVGs into symbols for the shared icon sprite.
